segments.thag16.4:1.3: Āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa natthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.
segments.thag16.4:2.3: Aṭṭhiṃ tacena onaddhaṃ, saha vatthehi sobhati.
segments.thag16.4:3.3: Alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.
segments.thag16.4:4.3: Alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.
segments.thag16.4:5.3: Alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.
segments.thag16.4:8.1: “Passāmi loke sadhane manusse, laddhāna vittaṃ na dadanti mohā;
segments.thag16.4:8.3: Luddhā dhanaṃ sannicayaṃ karonti, bhiyyova kāme abhipatthayanti.
segments.thag16.4:9.3: Oraṃ samuddassa atittarūpo, pāraṃ samuddassapi patthayetha.
segments.thag16.4:10.1: “Rājā ca aññe ca bahū manussā, avītataṇhā maraṇaṃ upenti;
segments.thag16.4:10.3: Ūnāva hutvāna jahanti dehaṃ, kāmehi lokamhi na hatthi titti.
segments.thag16.4:11.1: “Kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, aho vatā no amarāti cāhu;
segments.thag16.4:11.3: Vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samodhāya tato ḍahanti.
segments.thag16.4:12.1: “So ḍayhati sūlehi tujjamāno, ekena vatthena [etena gatthena (ka.)] pahāya bhoge;
segments.thag16.4:12.3: Na mīyamānassa bhavanti tāṇā, ñātī ca mittā atha vā sahāyā.
segments.thag16.4:13.1: “Dāyādakā tassa dhanaṃ haranti, satto pana gacchati yena kammaṃ;
segments.thag16.4:13.3: Na mīyamānaṃ dhanamanveti [manviti (ka.)] kiñci, puttā ca dārā ca dhanañca raṭṭhaṃ.
segments.thag16.4:14.1: “Na dīghamāyuṃ labhate dhanena, na cāpi vittena jaraṃ vihanti;
segments.thag16.4:14.3: Appappaṃ hidaṃ jīvitamāhu dhīrā, asassataṃ vippariṇāmadhammaṃ.
segments.thag16.4:15.1: “Aḍḍhā daliddā ca phusanti phassaṃ, bālo ca dhīro ca tatheva phuṭṭho;
segments.thag16.4:15.3: Bālo hi bālyā vadhitova seti, dhīro ca no vedhati phassaphuṭṭho.
segments.thag16.4:16.1: “Tasmā hi paññāva dhanena seyyā, yāya vosānamidhādhigacchati;
segments.thag16.4:16.3: Abyositattā hi bhavābhavesu, pāpāni kammāni karoti mohā.
segments.thag16.4:17.3: Tassappapañño abhisaddahanto, upeti gabbhañca parañca lokaṃ.
segments.thag16.4:18.1: “Coro yathā sandhimukhe gahīto, sakammunā haññati pāpadhammo;
segments.thag16.4:18.3: Evaṃ pajā pecca paramhi loke, sakammunā haññati pāpadhammo.
segments.thag16.4:19.1: “Kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā, virūparūpena mathenti cittaṃ;
segments.thag16.4:19.3: Ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā, tasmā ahaṃ pabbajitomhi rāja.
segments.thag16.4:20.1: “Dumapphalānīva patanti māṇavā, daharā ca vuḍḍhā ca sarīrabhedā;
segments.thag16.4:20.3: Etampi disvā pabbajitomhi rāja, apaṇṇakaṃ sāmaññameva seyyo.
segments.thag16.4:21.3: Avajjhā mayhaṃ pabbajjā, anaṇo bhuñjāmi bhojanaṃ.
segments.thag16.4:23.3: Sohaṃ viddho tadā santo, sampatto āsavakkhayaṃ.
